title: Compliance records sit in the asset card's Compliance section
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A compliance service on the asset with a current record. Seed it:
  4. ↳ Ensure a schedule with a compliance service exists and the asset is enrolled (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol).
  5. ↳ On the asset card Compliance section, click "+ Add record": choose a Type (e.g. CVIP), a Term, and an effective or expiry month; Save.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Compliance section on the asset card (below Contact) and the "+ Add record" control.
  2. Open a record from its line, and open the same form from the enrolment modal and from a work order.
  3. On a service that already has a record, look for Edit and a renewal control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The asset card has a Compliance section below Contact, one line per current record (e.g. "CVIP - AB-4471902 - expires Oct 2026"), each opening the record form, with "+ Add record" beneath; it shows whether or not the asset is on a schedule.
  • One record form serves two entry points: the enrolment modal's record row and the work order.
  • Where a record exists, the row shows it with Edit, and "+ Add record" stays beside it for a renewal.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S8; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
